risk_note: RV2 (catalog RV1; contracts/openapi.yaml and route-schemas.gen.ts are in the ledger paths but unchanged). catalog searchProducts use case: single-platform search with an inclusive price range, per-page sort and has_coupon (price steps go through union isPriceAnomaly first), a cursor holding only search_session_id and page_no, in-session dedup (cap keeps old keys), no-rebate filtering with at most one refill page, material-feed fallback (whitelist empty -> []), search switch (only boolean true is on; 50304 with reason=search_disabled) and union failures or a missing query pid as 50304 with data {platform}; a refill-page outage gives 50304 when the page has no card and degrades to the first page otherwise. Cards only through the B1-05i single card entry. The HTTP route stays x-implementation: planned: wiring LinkRegistrar, RebateQuoter, the governed union upstream and the Redis session store in app.module.ts is outside this task's paths and is split to B1-05j (orchestrator decision). The legacy createCardAssembler export stays (rule-test kits import it) and now checks price_status through isPriceAnomaly. Written by hand.
